signoff.title: Ready for your final review
signoff.body: The team finished and the reviewers signed off. Approve to apply the changes to your working tree (uncommitted). Reject with feedback to send it back to the coder. Abort to discard the run.

oscillation_detected.title: The team is going in circles
oscillation_detected.body: Two review rounds ended with the same problems, so the run paused instead of spending more budget. Approve to give the coder another try with a fresh iteration count. Reject with feedback to tell the team what to do differently (recommended). Abort to stop the run.

reviewer_conflict.title: Reviewers disagree
reviewer_conflict.body: The reviewers gave contradicting verdicts. Write in the feedback box which side is right, then Approve to continue with that guidance. Abort to stop the run.

inconsistent_verdict.title: A review contradicts itself
inconsistent_verdict.body: A reviewer blocked the change without a concrete blocking finding. Write how to proceed in the feedback box, then Approve. Abort to stop the run.

budget_exceeded.title: Budget used up
budget_exceeded.body: Budget limits have been removed. Approve to continue this older task.

max_iter_exceeded.title: Iteration limit reached
max_iter_exceeded.body: The run used all allowed review rounds. Enter a higher limit below and Approve to continue, or Reject with feedback to steer it. Abort to stop.

interrupted_call.title: A model call was interrupted
interrupted_call.body: The process stopped while a model call was in flight; the gateway may have billed it. Approve to retry it (it may be billed again). Abort to stop.

edit_conflict.title: File content conflicts with the recorded write
edit_conflict.body: Current files match neither their recorded originals nor intended results. Approve only rechecks and resumes safe pending writes; unresolved conflicts still pause. Reject with feedback to preserve current files and let the coder replan, or Abort to stop.

workspace_changed.title: Source changed; fresh review required
workspace_changed.body: Previous checks and reviews are stale. Approve to preserve current files and rerun checks and all reviewers. Reject with feedback to ask the coder for changes, or Abort to stop.

workspace_escape.title: Tried to write outside the project
workspace_escape.body: The coder tried to change a file outside the workspace or a protected file. Nothing was written. Approve to let the coder try again within the project. Abort to stop.

dispatch_invalid.title: Invalid model assignment
dispatch_invalid.body: Root assigned models or tasks that the project settings do not allow. Reject with feedback to regenerate the assignment. Abort to stop.

execution_error.title: The run hit an error
execution_error.body: A step failed (see the error type below, e.g. a gateway or key problem). Fix the cause, then Approve to retry from the same step. Abort to stop.

unknown.title: The run needs your decision
unknown.body: Approve to continue, Reject with feedback to steer it, or Abort to stop.

no_changes.title: The coder made no changes
no_changes.body: The coder finished without changing any file, so nothing was sent to review. Reject with feedback to give it what it needs (recommended), Approve to let it try again as is, or Abort.
